title: Weeknight Tomato Pasta
summary: A simple pantry pasta with garlic, tomatoes, and a little heat.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta until al dente.
Warm the olive oil in a skillet, then cook the garlic and red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and salt, then simmer for 12 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, parmesan, and basil before serving.

title: Citrus Breakfast Bowl
summary: Greek yogurt layered with citrus, oats, honey, and toasted seeds.
instructions: Spoon the Greek yogurt into a shallow bowl.
Arrange the orange and grapefruit slices over the yogurt.
Sprinkle the oats and pumpkin seeds across the top.
Finish with honey and a small pinch of flaky salt.

title: A Can of Ass Whoopin
summary: A tongue-in-cheek pantry special with big talk, bold flavor, and just enough heat to let everybody know supper means business.
ingredients: 1 pinch of red pepper flakes for dramatic effect
Fresh cracked black pepper and common sense
instructions: Pop the can of confidence and let it hiss like somebody just said they can do it better.
Warm the swagger in a cast-iron skillet, then stir in the sarcasm until the kitchen starts talking back.
Add the red pepper flakes and consequences, then cook everything down until the smell alone sets the record straight.
Finish with black pepper and common sense, then serve hot with a reminder that this recipe is strictly for laughs.
